title: SQL Console
tagline: An SQL console in your browser: type a query, run it and see the result as a table, with history.
summary: sql-console is an abap2UI5 app that runs an SQL query entered in the browser and shows the result as a table with search, filter, spreadsheet export and a per-user query history. The Open SQL console (src/abap) is ABAP-Cloud-clean; the native SQL console (src/native) runs statements through ADBC on Standard ABAP. Use it when you want a quick look at the data of a system without starting Eclipse or SAP GUI. It is a developer tool without authorization checks of its own, so read the Security section before using it beyond a development system.
features: ABAP SQL console (z2ui5_sql_cl_app_01) with Max Rows and a result table
Native SQL console via ADBC (zcl_2ui5_native_sql_console) on Standard ABAP
Search, range filter and spreadsheet export of the result
Per-user query history to reload or clear queries and results
Association path expressions mapped to joins in the native console
requirements: ABAP Cloud or Standard ABAP on NetWeaver 7.50 or higher
Native SQL console (ADBC) needs Standard ABAP; on ABAP Cloud use the Open SQL console

notes: Install with abapGit in this order: 1. abap2UI5, 2. popups, 3. custom-controls, 4. this repository (branch main)
Start with ?app_start=z2ui5_sql_cl_app_01 (Open SQL) or ?app_start=zcl_2ui5_native_sql_console (native, Standard ABAP only)
Add your own authorization checks before using it beyond a development system
